headline: HPE Boosts Outlook on Strong AI Demand Despite Share Price Volatility
summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise raised its financial forecast, citing record growth driven by robust demand for AI infrastructure, though its shares experienced volatile trading.
why: Hewlett Packard Enterprise is a global information technology supplier providing enterprise cloud, computing servers, and data storage infrastructure.

impacts.name: Hewlett Packard Enterprise
impacts.why: HPE reported record growth and raised its financial guidance on AI demand, though its stock traded volatilely.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: HPE raised its full-year outlook following its strongest historical growth, driven by sustained AI infrastructure spending.
